changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.

changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Restricted public build egress to hosts used during Dockerfile execution.
changes.details: Removed nvcr.io because digest-pinned base images are fetched through the separate verified base-image transfer and the build runs with pull disabled.

changes.summary: Marked the 360p recipe as the preferred default MOVA profile for one Spark.
changes.details: The synchronized-media execution contract is unchanged; the label distinguishes this profile from the tighter 720p candidate while physical acceptance remains pending.

changes.summary: Made synchronized MOVA media acceptance fail closed.
changes.details: Publication now requires one 640x352 H.264 stream with 193 frames at 24 fps and one synchronized 48 kHz AAC stream in the MP4 container.

changes.summary: Added signed typed prompt, optional reference-image, and MP4 result slots.
changes.details: The adapter now verifies the signed input manifest, reads the required bounded UTF-8 prompt before loading the model, and has no hidden default prompt.

changes.summary: Disambiguated the model title as MOVA 360p in catalog filters and details.
Replaced the non-executable Diffusers placeholder with the exact official MOVA native pipeline and a pinned ARM64 runtime.
Added optional image conditioning, the official white-frame T2VA fallback, and fail-closed synchronized video and 48 kHz audio verification.
Verified the fully pinned image build on linux/arm64 and kept the executable recipe Candidate pending only a physical single-Spark inference canary.
Marked the metadata-only candidate as requiring an immutable native MOVA source bundle and synchronized video/audio adapter before acceptance.
Initial reviewed catalog release of MOVA 360p diffusers single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
